plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Chemistry - Health Care Emphasis program page and its linked official degree map, 'Chemistry & Chemistry Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', 'Health Care (Campus)' tab, last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (16/15/16/16/15/15/12/15) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BS Degree: 120. The map's fixed chemistry courses sum to exactly the catalog's Required Chemistry Courses total of 45 credits, its biology courses to the Required Biology Courses total of 4, and its math courses to the Required Math Courses total of 8. The catalog's Required Physics Courses block (10 credits) offers two tracks (College Physics or Physics for Scientists and Engineers, lecture-plus-lab pairings); the map's two generic 5-credit Physics Course & Lab slots record those pairings with both tracks' courses carried as options. The catalog requires one emphasis track of 15-19 credits (Physical Chemistry 19, Inorganic Chemistry 15, Biochemistry 19, each with its own elective minimums); the map's five generic Chemistry Track slots total 19 credits and carry the three tracks' fixed courses as options, with the track structure disclosed on each slot. The catalog's printed Curriculum heading (82-86 credits) spans the track range; no header discrepancy was found in the blocks the map exercises. The catalog states this degree does not include the requisite number of upper-division hours and that students fill the upper-division requirement with elective credit, which the map's free-elective rows reflect. Catalog titles are recorded where the map shortens them (the map prints 'GE Physcial Sciences' [sic] on the first physics slot).

courses.title: Chemistry Track Course(s)
courses.choice_note: Printed in the degree map as 'Chemistry Track Course(s)*'. The catalog requires completion of one track (Physical Chemistry, 19 credits; Inorganic Chemistry, 15 credits; or Biochemistry, 19 credits): the tracks' fixed courses are CHEM 3620 + CHEM 3625 (Physical Chemistry), CHEM 4160 + CHEM 4165 (Inorganic Chemistry), and CHEM 4120 + CHEM 4125 + CHEM 4540 at 3 credits (Biochemistry), each followed by a minimum-credit elective list. Together with the other track slots in this plan, the map's generic track rows total 19 credits, the largest of the catalog's track totals.
